name: Terminus
description: Real-world zombie survival strategy game featuring 3D globe deployment, Safe Zones Operations radio directive system, OpenStreetMap tactical engine, HQ selection, itemized stockpiles, building adaptation, discrete survivor stats, labor allocation, real-time day/night clock, sound/proximity zombie AI, 3D RTS squad combat with melee and ranged weapons, infection & quarantine, motor pool vehicles, tech tree research, multi-settlement caravan trade network, settlement morale & passive population growth, dynamic seasons & weather, ambient soundscape & combat SFX.
